title: Introduce surge-sanitizer and ephemeral-circuit-lock for controlled regional stall recovery
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: Hotfix: add regional surge sanitization and ephemeral circuit lock to prevent cascaded stalls; telemetry added for post-incident analysis.
description: Context: We observed two recent incidents where a rapid burst of requests in a single region led to a cascade of slowpath fallbacks and repeated circuit flips, causing increased tail latency and tenant impact. This PR introduces two small, orthogonal defenses: (1) surge-sanitizer, a short-window admission controller that applies a graceful 'soft-drop' with weighted tenant drain to smooth bursts without hard-deny, and (2) ephemeral-circuit-lock, a short-lived circuit state that prevents immediate reopen attempts for recently failed circuits while allowing gradual reheating. Motivation: previous mitigations either overreacted (hard-deny) or allowed rapid reopen/flapping that amplified load. The goal here is to reduce tail amplification during region-localized spikes while minimizing false positives and preserving throughput for healthy tenants. Changes: implemented a lightweight token-bucket window in the regional ingress path (surge-sanitizer) with per-tenant weight profiles; added a short-lived circuit lock (default 5s) that records a minimal recovery score and enforces exponential re-open backoff with jitter; added KV-prefetch gating to avoid expensive slowpath prefetches for tenants in the soft-drop window; instruments: new histograms and labeled counters for sanitize_decisions, circuit_lock_events, and tenant_weighted_drop_rate. Backwards-compat: all features are opt-in by feature-flag and default to conservative thresholds; no protocol changes to client-facing APIs. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on main; staged rollout to us-west-2, eu-west-1 with canary traffic (2% -> 20% -> 100%) and live SLO watch; automatic fallback to previous behavior if error rate rises beyond threshold. Commits summary: - 1f3b9d4: add surge-sanitizer admission controller and tests - 7a2c1b0: add ephemeral-circuit-lock state machine and backoff strategy - 4c9e2a7: gate KV-prefetch behind sanitizer and add defensive checks - 9b8f7a1: telemetry: counters, histograms, dashboards + unit tests Review notes: requested more unit tests around jitter correctness and a tighter metric label set. I adjusted and added deterministic tests that validate the backoff jitter distribution and the weight decay behavior for tenant drain. Observability: dashboards added include a per-region 'surge_sanitizer' panel, circuit_lock heatmap, and tenant-level drop-rate flashcards. CI: full test suite green; perf benchmark run on synthetic spike workload shows 42% reduction in 99.9th tail latency under moderate bursts and 11% throughput drop at extreme overload compared to hard-deny baseline. Safety: added a kill-switch that disables KV-prefetch gating in case of unexpected latency regressions. Related work: references incident SUP-3421, prior soft-shed experiments ENG-1987, and convo in #sre-ops.
